title: 12 Best Wine Bars in Cartagena
description: Uncork the best of Cartagena's wine scene! Discover top wine bars, from historic cellars to rooftop views, offering exquisite selections and perfect pairings in the Walled City.

places.name: El Burlador Gasterobar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy a robust Rioja paired with their Gambas al Ajillo or a selection of Iberian cured meats.

places.name: Carmen Cartagena
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Opt for the tasting menu with the wine pairing to experience the full breadth of their culinary and oenological expertise.

places.name: Alma Restaurante & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A crisp, cool white wine (like a Sauvignon Blanc) pairs wonderfully with their signature seafood dishes, especially the Catch of the Day.

places.name: 1621 Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their extensive Bordeaux or Burgundy selections to complement their exquisite steak or duck dishes.

places.name: Enoteca 1920
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for their daily specials on wine by the glass, and pair it with a gourmet cheese and charcuterie board.

places.name: La Vitrola
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy a smooth Merlot or Cabernet Sauvignon with their classic local fish or Ropa Vieja.

places.name: Mar y Zielo Cocina de Origen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A light-bodied Pinot Noir or a dry Riesling can wonderfully enhance the complex flavors of their seafood or pork dishes.

places.name: Mistura
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pair their renowned Cebiche Clásico with a crisp Albariño or a refreshing Torrontés.

places.name: El Santísimo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A full-bodied Malbec complements their acclaimed beef tenderloin dishes perfectly.

places.name: Restaurant Club de Pesca
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A refreshing bottle of Chilean Sauvignon Blanc pairs perfectly with their grilled whole fish or classic Cartagena seafood platter.

places.name: Alquímico
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Choose a glass of their excellent house Malbec or Sauvignon Blanc to enjoy on the bustling rooftop.

places.name: Cuzco Cocina Peruana
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A crisp, acidic Torrontés or a dry Rosé is the ideal accompaniment to any of their fresh ceviche preparations.
